mapper.sql: v.vehicle_id, v.plate_no, v.model_nm, v.year_model, v.purchase_dt, v.fuel_type_cd, v.fuel_efficiency, v.seats, v.owner_dept_id, d.dept_nm AS owner_dept_nm, v.current_mileage, v.status_cd, v.next_maintenance_dt, v.memo
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_vehicle (plate_no, model_nm, year_model, purchase_dt, fuel_type_cd, fuel_efficiency, seats, owner_dept_id, current_mileage, status_cd, next_maintenance_dt, memo) VALUES (#{plateNo}, #{modelNm}, #{yearModel}, #{purchaseDt}, COALESCE(#{fuelTypeCd},'GASOLINE'), #{fuelEfficiency}, COALESCE(#{seats}, 5), #{ownerDeptId}, COALESCE(#{currentMileage}, 0), COALESCE(#{statusCd},'AVAILABLE'), #{nextMaintenanceDt}, #{memo})
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_vehicle SET model_nm = #{modelNm}, year_model = #{yearModel}, purchase_dt = #{purchaseDt}, fuel_type_cd = #{fuelTypeCd}, fuel_efficiency = #{fuelEfficiency}, seats = #{seats}, owner_dept_id = #{ownerDeptId}, current_mileage = #{currentMileage}, next_maintenance_dt = #{nextMaintenanceDt}, memo = #{memo} WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE gw_vehicle SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId}
UPDATE gw_vehicle SET status_cd = #{statusCd} WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_vehicle v LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = v.owner_dept_id WHERE v.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND v.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM gw_vehicle v LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = v.owner_dept_id WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY v.status_cd, v.plate_no
SELECT FROM gw_vehicle v LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = v.owner_dept_id WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.status_cd IN ('AVAILABLE','IN_USE') ORDER BY v.plate_no
mapper.sql: r.reservation_id, r.vehicle_id, vh.plate_no, vh.model_nm, r.user_id, u.name AS user_name, r.start_dt, r.end_dt, r.purpose, r.destination, r.passenger_cnt, r.mileage_start, r.mileage_end, r.status_cd, r.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_vehicle_reservation (vehicle_id, user_id, start_dt, end_dt, purpose, destination, passenger_cnt, mileage_start, status_cd) VALUES (#{vehicleId}, #{userId}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, #{purpose}, #{destination}, COALESCE(#{passengerCnt}, 1), #{mileageStart}, COALESCE(#{statusCd}, 'APPROVED'))
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_vehicle_reservation SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status_cd = 'CANCELED' WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{roleCd} IN ('ADMIN','HR_MANAGER'))
UPDATE gw_vehicle_reservation SET status_cd = #{statusCd} WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_vehicle_reservation r JOIN gw_vehicle vh ON vh.vehicle_id = r.vehicle_id JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId}

SELECT FROM gw_vehicle_reservation r JOIN gw_vehicle vh ON vh.vehicle_id = r.vehicle_id JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.start_dt DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT FROM gw_vehicle_reservation r JOIN gw_vehicle vh ON vh.vehicle_id = r.vehicle_id JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.end_dt >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY r.start_dt LIMIT #{limit}
